newsitem.title: USA: Resource Feb mortgage production down.
newsitem.headline: Resource Feb mortgage production down.

text.p: Resource Bancshares Mortgage Group Inc said Thursday its February 1997 mortgage loan production was $614.1 million, a 39 percent decrease from February 1996 production of $1.0 billion.
For the two months ended February 28, 1997, mortgage loan production was $1.3 billion, a 35 percent decrease from the loan production level of $1.9 billion for the same period of 1996, Resource said.
The company said its locked mortgage loan pipeline was $996.3 million at February 28, 1997, compared with $1.046 billion at February 29, 1996.
At February 28, 1997, the company said its owned servicing portfolio was $7.3 billion compared with $6.2 billion at February 29, 1996, which represents an increase of 18 percent.

The servicing portfolio had a weighted average note rate of 7.83 percent at February 28, 1997, and the portfolio's delinquency rate, including bankruptcies and foreclosures, was 3.29 percent, the company said.
